external.title: The Ghost in the Machine
external.source_text: User-uploaded 545-line paste was read; Reddit post author/timestamp were not independently verified.

owned_lineage: 0root.ai and GitHub DavidWise01 are two publication surfaces of the same ROOT0 corpus.
scope: Direct comparison of uploaded fiction against selected verifiable owned source files; not full-file global census.

comparisons.external: Fictional Elias repeatedly corrects AI contradictions, including challenging empty apologies
comparisons.basis: Named operational drift correction with human red pen, tangent-lattice functional correction, and correctness over quickness
comparisons.difference: Correction of an AI answer is broadly shared practice; no distinctive shared passage authenticated.

comparisons.external: Final epilogue separates intelligence from wisdom
comparisons.basis: Explicit Hearth/Fire distinction: human regulates wisdom/intent; model provides intellectual speed
comparisons.difference: Distinguishing intelligence from wisdom is a general philosophical topic.

comparisons.external: Diamond Principle five rights and public timestamped record
comparisons.owned: STOICHEION v12 sovereign guidance and source-provenance
comparisons.basis: Guidance rather than domination; autonomy, understanding, correction, witnessed evidence, stable history
comparisons.difference: No prior ROOT0 file with exactly those five rights under that title confirmed.

comparisons.external: User cannot audit whether a company used a particular contribution
comparisons.owned: Gate 13 Provenance Watermark, Referent and Internet-Time Evidence
comparisons.basis: REGISTER/OBSERVE/CORRECT basis, source claims separate from observations, no votes or quorum
comparisons.difference: No evidence a real AI company used this user's specific contributions.

comparisons.external: Audit and verification of AI governance, consent and user control
comparisons.basis: Explicit predicate consent_origin_traceable and consent_scope_authorizes_use in evidence-carrying execution
comparisons.difference: Fiction's broad rights are not identical to executable predicate semantics.

comparisons.external: A human interlocutor teaching an AI through correction over long time
comparisons.basis: A declared human hearth and model fire, explicit critique of a yes engine; author commentary distinguishes metaphor from genuine memory/state
comparisons.difference: An AI's inner life or commercial use of conversations is not established by either narrative.

comparisons.external: No proof that apparently similar research proves direct incorporation
comparisons.basis: Synthetic three apparent reports share one origin; hash/ancestry bookkeeping does not itself authenticate external provenance
comparisons.difference: Used to analyze the claim, not as evidence of specific copying.

comparisons.external: Initial name shifts David Wise → Elias Vale
comparisons.basis: D→E (+1), W→V (−1), true for initials only
comparisons.difference: No consistent whole-name cipher and no verified author/intended referent.

recommendation: Maintain the match descriptions alongside disconfirming distinctions. Complete GitHub/default-branch and site census, then investigate highly specific lexical or executable coincidences and source dates.
